item.title: SAI NSNIS Patiala To Host International Conference 'Grassroots To Greatness' On Feb 6 To 7
item.description: Netaji Subhas National Institute: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NSNIS), Patiala, the apex national institute for sports coaching and sports science education under the Sports Authority of India (SAI), will organise an international conference titled “Grassroots to Greatness: Talent Identification and Athlete Development” on February 6-7 aligned with the nation’s long-term vision and preparation for the 2036 Summer Olympic Games.

item.title: Mitchell Santner Hails Aggressive Powerplay as New Zealand Bounce Back Against India in 4th T20I
item.description: New Zealand captain Mitchell Santner praised his team’s aggressive powerplay approach after a 50-run win over India, calling it ideal preparation ahead of the Men’s T20 World Cup.

item.title: PGTI School: Jhared Hack Builds Three-shot Lead On Day Two Of final qualifying stage
item.description: Sawai Hamendra Singh Bhati: American Jhared Hack, who had won Pre-Qualifying III last week, shot a second straight two-under 70 to move his total to four-under 140 and build a three-shot lead on day two of the final qualifying stage of the PGTI Qualifying School 2026 being played at the Kensville Golf & Country Club in Ahmedabad.

item.title: South Africa vs West Indies, 2nd T20I- Who will win today SA vs WI match?
item.description: The second T20I between South Africa and West Indies will be played at SuperSport Park in Centurion on Thursday at 9:30 PM IST.

item.title: Railways, Rajasthan Among Winners At Women’s Senior Nationals
item.description: Senior National Kabaddi Championship: Day 2 of the 72nd Women’s Senior National Kabaddi Championship at the Balayogi Stadium saw a full schedule of league matches across pools, as teams continued to jostle for position in the competition.

item.title: Sophie Molineux Named Australian Women's All-format Captain
item.description: Royal Australian Air Force: Sophie Molineux has been appointed captain of the Australian Women’s Team, taking the reins from Alyssa Healy who will retire from all formats in March, Cricket Australia said on Thursday.

item.title: Coimbatore To Get Its First Dedicated Paralympic Sports Complex, Boosting Inclusive Athletics
item.description: Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation: Coimbatore is poised to take a decisive leap towards inclusive sports development, with the Tamil Nadu government granting Administrative Sanction for the city’s first exclusive Paralympic Sports Complex.

item.title: Shivam Dube Credits Regular Game Time for Strong Mindset After India’s 50-Run Loss to New Zealand
item.description: After India’s 50-run defeat to New Zealand in the fourth T20I, all-rounder Shivam Dube reflected on his 15-ball half-century, saying regular match exposure has helped him handle pressure situations and sharpen his mindset.

item.title: Champions League: Madrid Drop To Play-offs, Five English Clubs Move Into Round Of 16
item.description: Goalkeeper Anatoliy Trubin: Real Madrid were defeated in Lisbon by Benfica and finished ninth and will have to face a play-off to reach the last 16 of the Champions League against Benfica or Bodo/Glimt.

item.title: Sophie Molineux Named Australia Women’s Captain Across All Formats
item.description: Spin-bowling allrounder Sophie Molineux has been appointed captain of the Australian women’s cricket team in all three formats, succeeding retiring skipper Alyssa Healy, with leadership duties beginning against India next month.
